name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-review-due-date-override
_comment: Additive per-engagement operational review due-date override. Null means fall back to akoya_request.wmkf_reviewduedate. DateOnly prevents timezone drift across portal display, reminder scheduling, calendar attachments, and token-expiry math. This mutable field is not immutable communicated-deadline evidence. Deploy this wave before runtime code that selects the field. Run scripts/preflight-reviewer-due-date-override-field.mjs first; schema apply is creation-only and will not repair a divergent existing field.

attributes.description: Optional operational review deadline for this reviewer engagement. Empty uses the request-level review due date. Mutable and audited; not the source of truth for historical communicated-deadline evidence.
